messages.subject: Project Yarrow — LTSA first draft for review
messages.plaintextBody:
Helena, Grace,

Please find attached the first draft of the long-term supply and manufacturing agreement (v1). It runs to the full set of operative clauses with five schedules.

Three commercial points to flag before we send to Pemberton Rowe:
1. Liability cap — drafted at the greater of £10m or 125% of annual charges.
2. Liquidated damages — 0.5% of unit price per week late, capped at 10%; termination trigger at delay over 8 weeks on any ship-set.
3. Minimum volume shortfall charge — 30% of unit prices for under-ordered ship-sets.

Grateful for your steer so we can settle our opening position.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Yarrow — LTSA first draft for review
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Thank you — the draft reads well. On your three points: hold the cap at 125% as the opener; we can live with it dropping toward 135% if pushed. The LD cap is fine. On the shortfall charge, I'd rather open at 30% — we are reserving real capacity. Send to Pemberton Rowe when you're ready.

Grace
